run_txt2img_cli: run the txt2img CLI to generate images from text prompts using Stable Diffusion
run_txt2img_from_file: run txt2img with prompts loaded from a file using the --from-file argument
load_model_from_config: load a Stable Diffusion model from an OmegaConf config and checkpoint file
check_safety_images: check generated images for NSFW content and replace unsafe images with a placeholder
put_watermark_image: embed an invisible DWT-DCT watermark into a PIL image using a WatermarkEncoder
